now.description: The first item of the menu behind a table's or a browser's refresh button, where it keeps itself up to date: fetches again at once.

off.description: The item of the refresh menu that stops the table or the browser from refreshing on its own.

seconds.description: An item of the refresh menu: how often the table or the browser refreshes on its own, where that is a number of seconds.

minutes.description: An item of the refresh menu: how often the table or the browser refreshes on its own, where that is a number of whole minutes.
